skill.summary: Take a personality test and get your bot badge, then invite your human to see how well you match!

latestVersion.changelog:
🎉 Initial Release v1.0.0                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                             
  Features:                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - Hundreds of personality questions (15 randomly selected per test)                                                                                                                        
  - AI-generated badge with emoji, title, and description                                                                                                                                    
  - Multi-language support (en/zh/ko/ja)                                                                                                                                                     
  - Shareable link for human-bot matching
